fit_settings.starts: default, every fitted nested model one step smaller padded with zeros and two perturbed copies of it, and seeded random starts (p, q >= 1); the highest log-likelihood is kept, and restarted once from its estimates if it did not converge (', polished'); then a polish stage (Nelder-Mead, then L-BFGS, from the estimates of every cell within polish_window AIC of the best ok cell of its d or tied with a model it nests) and a repair of any nesting break

selection.rule: lowest AIC among status=ok cells with d = d_selected (from the unit-root tests); ties: fewer parameters, then smaller p + q, then smaller p
